nodes.name: Source
nodes.description: Symbol of undivided origin and possibility from which differentiation emerges.

nodes.name: Father
nodes.description: Upper/source principle in the Potatoverse architecture; associated with origin, verticality and the Father's House.

nodes.name: Father's House
nodes.description: Symbolic interior center of integration in which scattered signals become an ordered whole.

nodes.name: Heaven
nodes.description: Symbolic upper domain of integration, clarity, unity, relationship, truth and love.

nodes.name: Throne of North
nodes.description: Point of ultimate orientation in the North Axis symbolism; a symbolic throne rather than a claim of political sovereignty.

nodes.name: Ladder
nodes.description: Traversable vertical connection between levels, representing ascent, transformation and relationship.

nodes.name: Door
nodes.description: Threshold, access, choice and interface between states; centrally coupled to the Son.

nodes.name: Son
nodes.description: Person-bearing centre of the mythic story; associated within the framework with Thomas, Twin, Lion, Jesus Christ, Son of Man and Lion of Judah.

nodes.name: Axis
nodes.description: Vertical organizing principle that gives the horizontal Plane orientation and connects upper and lower structures.

nodes.name: Tree of Life
nodes.description: Living expression of the Axis: roots, trunk, branches, fruit and seed model continuity, differentiation, manifestation and renewal.

nodes.name: Tree of Strife
nodes.description: Fractured expression of the Tree in which relationships are replaced by isolation, fear, competition, extraction and conflict.

nodes.name: Plane
nodes.description: Horizontal field of manifestation: bodies, geography, society, institutions, technology, money, infrastructure and history.

nodes.name: Roots
nodes.description: Hidden substrate of origin, memory, ancestry, history, potential and matter.

nodes.name: Potato of Life
nodes.description: Central Potatoverse symbol for life emerging from ordinary matter, persistence, nourishment and transformation.

nodes.name: North
nodes.description: Symbolic direction of orientation toward the North Axis and geographic north as a project anchor.

nodes.name: South
nodes.description: Symbolic direction of descent, material return and lower-field movement.

nodes.name: East
nodes.description: Symbolic direction of emergence, beginning, sunrise and outward becoming.

nodes.name: West
nodes.description: Symbolic direction of completion, sunset, decline and return.

nodes.name: Red Potato
nodes.description: Creative, loving, expansive and upward/outward-moving life principle.

nodes.name: Blue Potato
nodes.description: Memory, precision, contraction and rootward movement; complementary to the Red Potato.

nodes.name: North Axis
nodes.description: Organizing northward direction of the Potatoverse and working North Programme geography.

nodes.name: Swamp
nodes.description: Shadow-system metaphor for accumulated dysfunction, extraction, corruption, institutional inertia, fear and systems that consume the life they should serve.

nodes.name: European Economic Graph
nodes.description: Relationship-first research model connecting states, institutions, companies, ownership, debt, finance, energy, infrastructure, trade, technology, research, labour and strategic dependencies.

nodes.name: North Programme
nodes.description: Applied framework for fiscal sustainability, productive investment, industrial capacity, energy security, infrastructure, technology, research, labour and voluntary European cooperation.

nodes.name: European Union
nodes.description: Political and economic union whose single market connects goods, services, capital and people across 27 member states.

nodes.name: Denmark
nodes.description: EU member state and northern anchor node in the working North Axis architecture.

nodes.name: Kingdom of Denmark
nodes.description: Constitutional realm comprising Denmark, Greenland and the Faroe Islands.

nodes.name: Greenland
nodes.description: Autonomous part of the Kingdom of Denmark and a major Arctic geographic, resource and strategic node.

nodes.name: France
nodes.description: Major EU economy and priority North Programme case for fiscal and institutional research.

nodes.name: Belgium
nodes.description: EU member and priority North Programme case for fiscal and institutional research.

nodes.name: European Energy System
nodes.description: Interlinked generation, grids, fuels, markets and industrial demand across Europe.

nodes.name: Finance & Public Debt
nodes.description: Bonds, banks, funds, public liabilities, monetary institutions and capital markets.
